top_module.name: adaptive_aero_control_top
top_module.description: Top-level FPGA digital IP for active-aerodynamics supervision and actuation. It exposes a 32-bit Wishbone slave CSR/MMIO interface for firmware-mediated control, bounded actuator command outputs, compact vehicle status input sampling, and an interrupt output. It implements command sequence acceptance, aging supervision, stale rejection, timeout fallback, clamping, latched faults, and write-1-to-clear IRQ status semantics. It does not expose any geometry/tensor/flow-field payloads at the top level.
top_module.functionality: Implements a firmware-controlled active-aerodynamics command register file and safety supervisor. The module accepts software-issued command words and sequence numbers through the Wishbone register map, validates them against enable state and freshness rules, clamps each actuator field between configured limits, updates bounded actuator outputs only from accepted/clamped values, and asserts fallback safe state upon stale data, timeout, or disabled control. The module reports status, fault codes, and sticky interrupt bits through readback registers and supports clear-on-write semantics for selected fault and IRQ status fields.
responsibilities: Expose a real firmware-visible 32-bit Wishbone CSR/MMIO interface with address, write-data, read-data, byte select, transaction valid, write enable, acknowledge, and error response semantics.
Implement the mandated register map at 32-bit word granularity with RTL decode for every declared register.
Track command sequence freshness, accept only strictly newer commands when enabled, and reject stale commands after the programmed age threshold.
Clamp actuator command fields independently between ACT_MIN0 and ACT_MAX0.
Drive only bounded actuator command outputs to the actuator interface.
Latch faults and sticky IRQ status bits until cleared by software or replaced by a valid command acceptance where permitted by policy.
Assert fallback behavior deterministically to SAFE_STATE0 on reset, timeout, stale rejection, or control disable.
Provide compact status sampling from status_i without exposing any high-dimensional or bulk payloads at the top level.
top_module.reset_behavior: On rst_ni deassertion, the module synchronously loads SAFE_STATE0 as the initial actuator output, clears command age tracking, clears latched fault and IRQ status state, deasserts active, and keeps fallback_active asserted until a valid command is accepted and CTRL.enable is set. Read data, acknowledge, and interrupt outputs are driven to reset-safe values.
behavior_rules: Wishbone reads and writes shall acknowledge with a single-cycle ack_o pulse on accepted transactions.
Invalid or unmapped addresses may return zero on dat_o and may assert err_o when implemented, but must not create multi-cycle bus dependencies.
CTRL.bit0 enables control; CTRL.bit1 clears latched faults when written; CTRL.bit2 arms fallback override policy if implemented; CTRL.bit3 enables IRQ generation.

STATUS.bit0 reflects active; bit1 reflects fallback_active; bit2 reflects stale_reject; bit3 reflects timeout_fault; bit4 reflects clamp_event; bit5 reflects cmd_valid; higher bits summarize fault/counter state.
CMD_SEQ stores the last written software sequence value and is used for strict monotonic acceptance checks.
CMD_AGE_MAX bounds command validity age in cycles/control ticks.
ACT_MIN0 and ACT_MAX0 define per-field clamp boundaries for the primary actuator command word.
ACT_CMD0 and ACT_CMD1 are software request registers; only the clamped and accepted command is driven to actuator_cmd_o.
SAFE_STATE0 is the deterministic fallback actuator word and is the reset-defined safe output source.
VEH_SPEED samples compact vehicle status input data in fixed-point format from status_i.
FAULT_CODE is a latched fault register; writing clear_fault via CTRL or writing the relevant clear mechanism clears latched faults per the contract.
IRQ_STATUS contains sticky write-1-to-clear event bits for timeout, stale, clamp, and accepted-command interrupts.
VERSION provides module version and compatibility fields, read-only.
The design shall not invent a streaming model transport at the top level; command acceptance is firmware-mediated through the CSR/MMIO interface.
All outputs shall be registered or derived from registered state suitable for straightforward FPGA synthesis at 50 MHz.
No top-level port shall expose geometry, tensor, flow-field, or bulk payload interfaces.

top_level_connections.description: Top synchronous clock input is consumed by the top-level controller logic.
Top active-low reset input initializes the controller and register state.
Wishbone address input for CSR/MMIO decode.
Wishbone write-data input for register programming.
Wishbone byte-select input for partial register writes.
Compact vehicle/status sample input consumed by the top-level controller.
Wishbone read-data output from the controller register file.
Wishbone acknowledge output pulse for accepted transactions.
Wishbone error output for invalid or unsupported accesses when implemented.
Registered compact actuator command output driven only by bounded, accepted values.
Interrupt output indicating accepted-command and safety-event conditions per enabled IRQ policy.

registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Control register for enable, fault clearing, fallback policy, and IRQ gating.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Live status summary including active/fallback/fault indicators.

registers.name: CMD_SEQ
registers.description: Sequence number for command freshness tracking and strict monotonic acceptance.

registers.name: CMD_AGE_MAX
registers.description: Maximum acceptable command age in control cycles or ticks before stale rejection.

registers.name: ACT_MIN0
registers.description: Packed minimum limit for the primary actuator command word.

registers.name: ACT_MAX0
registers.description: Packed maximum limit for the primary actuator command word.

registers.name: SAFE_STATE0
registers.description: Deterministic safe fallback actuator command word used on reset and fallback.

registers.name: VEH_SPEED
registers.description: Compact vehicle-speed/status input sample in fixed-point format.

registers.name: FAULT_CODE
registers.description: Latched fault code; clear-fault semantics clear this register and associated fault latches.

registers.name: IRQ_STATUS
registers.description: Sticky event bits for timeout, stale, clamp, and accepted-command interrupts.
